title: Navigation refusal reasons
hypothesis: When navigate_to refuses, saying why (a message is waiting for B, the target is a person or object with the free tiles to stand on, a wall or water with the nearest reachable tile, or outside the map) stops repeated identical navigate_to calls, so fewer turns are lost before RIVAL_HOUSE_ENTERED and more runs reach it.
notes: Registered 2026-10-15 (harness-fixes-bundle worklog, M3). Evidence: run 0c40 called navigate_to(10,7) 42 times while a message waited for B and got the generic "field input or navigation geometry unavailable"; c497 retried navigate_to onto a wandering NPC's tile. Activation is PLAYER_NAME_CONFIRMED because navigate_to (bounded-navigation-v1, activation PLAYER_NAME_CONFIRMED) is already available in the truck, where a refusal can first occur (truck boxes are solid tiles, and messages open there). Provisional source.commit a85b591 (branch claude/r3-fixes, the parent of the round-3 fix commit; it contains this switch's implementation but not the round-3 fixes). It is repinned to the merge SHA on main with `just experiment-pin` when the bundle lands; until then this entry is not reproducible from main.
